items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, do not monetize, expand alerts, deploy, alter tracking, or send permission outreach. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal data; public terms restrict those uses. Fleet compliance is technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Analytics data quality is yellow from source permission or collector errors; revenue is partial aggregate with $4.92 unattributed; operations and fleet-doctor sweeps are unavailable; security controls remain unevidenced. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, privacy/jurisdiction, and any affiliate or advertising use. Ordinary telemetry gaps alone do not block unrelated reversible growth.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing progress is evidenced by official Woot API, terms, and support records; repository/configuration artifacts; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft terms. No task closes because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance; permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, and incident inventory. No go-live proposal is supported.

Retain complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net as parked/private or preview-only. No public launch, monetization, analytics activation, or deployment is cleared from this legal pass. Concrete blocker: each candidate lacks a complete launch-readiness artifact, verified execution-owner evidence, and cross-functional security, accuracy, measurement, and compliance gates. Next evidence action: attach the dated execution-owner record and site-specific compliance checklist for complicated.work; do not change launch state.
